mapper.update: UPDATE chemical_stock SET available_quantity = available_quantity - #{lockQuantity}, locked_quantity = locked_quantity + #{lockQuantity}, available_pack_count = GREATEST(COALESCE(available_pack_count, available_quantity, 0) - #{lockQuantity}, 0), locked_pack_count = COALESCE(locked_pack_count, locked_quantity) + #{lockQuantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND available_quantity >= #{lockQuantity}

UPDATE chemical_stock SET available_quantity = available_quantity + #{unlockQuantity}, locked_quantity = GREATEST(locked_quantity - #{unlockQuantity}, 0), available_pack_count = COALESCE(available_pack_count, available_quantity) + #{unlockQuantity}, locked_pack_count = GREATEST(COALESCE(locked_pack_count, locked_quantity, 0) - #{unlockQuantity}, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND locked_quantity >= #{unlockQuantity}

UPDATE chemical_stock SET total_quantity = GREATEST(total_quantity - #{outQuantity}, 0), total_pack_count = GREATEST(COALESCE(total_pack_count, total_quantity, 0) - #{outQuantity}, 0), locked_quantity = CASE WHEN locked_quantity >= #{outQuantity} THEN locked_quantity - #{outQuantity} ELSE locked_quantity END, locked_pack_count = CASE WHEN locked_quantity >= #{outQuantity} THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(locked_pack_count, locked_quantity, 0) - #{outQuantity}, 0) ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(locked_pack_count, locked_quantity, 0), 0) END, available_quantity = CASE WHEN locked_quantity >= #{outQuantity} THEN available_quantity ELSE GREATEST(available_quantity - #{outQuantity}, 0) END, available_pack_count = CASE WHEN locked_quantity >= #{outQuantity} THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(available_pack_count, available_quantity, 0), 0) ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(available_pack_count, available_quantity, 0) - #{outQuantity}, 0) END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND (locked_quantity >= #{outQuantity} OR available_quantity >= #{outQuantity})

UPDATE chemical_stock SET total_quantity = COALESCE(total_quantity, 0) + #{inQuantity}, available_quantity = COALESCE(available_quantity, 0) + #{inQuantity}, total_pack_count = GREATEST(COALESCE(total_pack_count, COALESCE(total_quantity, 0), 0), 0) + #{inQuantity}, available_pack_count = GREATEST(COALESCE(available_pack_count, COALESCE(available_quantity, 0), 0), 0) + #{inQuantity}, last_in_date = CURDATE(), status = CASE WHEN COALESCE(available_quantity, 0) + #{inQuantity} <= 0 THEN 'out_of_stock' WHEN COALESCE(safety_stock, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(available_quantity, 0) + #{inQuantity} < COALESCE(safety_stock, 0) THEN 'low_stock' ELSE 'active' END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
